result.title: Do Deep Stereo Models Learn Shape Priors?
result.summary: Localizing object boundaries is important for embodied visual systems, since small boundary errors can change the inferred geometry of physical surfaces. We study whether deep stereo models produce boundaries consistent with simple shape priors when local image and disparity cues are weak. We create a synthetic stereo dataset consisting of objects drawn from a highly constrained family of shapes, with randomized depth, slant, color and texture. Despite the simplicity of this shape space, we find that several state-of-the-art stereo models retain systematic boundary errors, even when finetuned or trained from scratch on the dataset. We then introduce a simple generative stereo model that jointly predicts disparity and a distance field representing object boundaries. The model improves boundary localization and produces contours that adhere more closely to the underlying shape space. These results expose limitations in the boundary predictions of current stereo architectures when local evidence is weak, and motivate further study of whether generative models can better combine regional grouping evidence with global geometric structure.

AI.brief_summary: 论文构建形状高度受限的合成双目数据集，检验多种先进立体匹配模型在局部图像与视差线索薄弱时是否仍产生符合形状先验的边界，发现即使从头训练仍存在系统性边界误差，并提出联合预测视差与表示物体边界距离场的生成式立体模型以改善边界定位。
AI.relevance_reason: 其中「弱局部证据下边界与全局几何结构」的诊断，以及用距离场作为辅助几何表示的联合预测，可能为 LVR 中几何与任务必要信息如何保留在内部状态、以及辅助监督提供可供核查的线索，但该文不涉及多模态推理或 latent 推理状态生成。
